findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` and `documentTenant` differ, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`, allowing unauthorized cross-tenant reads. Preserve the previous tenant equality check unless this access-policy change is explicitly intended and safely enforced elsewhere.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality validation before granting document reads
findings.body:
Any user can read a document belonging to another tenant because differing tenant IDs (for example, `"tenant-a"` and `"tenant-b"`) now return `true`, bypassing tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document authorization
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` receives `true`, enabling unauthorized cross-tenant document reads wherever this exported guard is enforced.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
